description: One key and one USD wallet to call 363 scraping and data APIs through a single normalized interface, with automatic provider failover.

tools.name: list_apis
tools.description: Browse APIs, optionally filtered by category. Returns identity and nested USD pricing; descriptions, lanes, health, and schemas are omitted.

tools.name: search_apis
tools.description: Ranked API search. Args: query; optional category, platform, and limit. Adds descriptions and relevance to list fields; lanes, health, and schemas are omitted.

tools.name: get_api
tools.description: Full API definition with nested USD pricing, anonymous lanes, and normalized input/output JSON Schema. Args: sku_id.

tools.name: quote_api
tools.description: Price a run_api call before running it. Free, no key required, nothing charged; also validates your input. Args: sku_id, input. Returns maxCostUsd, minCostUsd, and the base/per-item breakdown.

tools.name: run_api
tools.description: Execute an API. Args: sku_id, input. Returns output, provider ("AnyAPI"), costUsd, items, resultId. Supports context-budget controls (fields, max_items, summary, jq).

tools.name: read_result
tools.description: Re-read a prior run result for free. Args: result_id plus the same context-budget controls. Unbilled, ~15 min window.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Remaining wallet balance in USD for your key.

authentication.description: Hosted Claude and ChatGPT connect to the URL and complete OAuth. Non-OAuth clients may send a Bearer aa_live_ API key. Mint a free trial key with no human via the signup endpoint - about $0.05 of requests, no account created, self-expires in 7 days.
